question: A ______ is an electronic device that receives a weak signal and regenerates it.
solution:
Correct Answer **repeater**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **repeater **is a device that receives a **signal**, amplifies it, and then **re-transmits it to extend its range or reach.**
 
• **Repeaters** are commonly used in** telecommunications** and** broadcasting** to **increase the coverage area of signals**, particularly in **areas with obstacles** or** weak signal strength.**
 
• **Repeaters **can also be used in **networking to extend the range** of a **wireless network or to improve signal quality.**
 
• Additionally, in firearms, a **"repeater"** can refer to a **type of gun **that can **quickly fire multiple rounds** without needing to** reload after each shot.**
